subject: CPPO reseller launch: evidence rotation, demo windows, and entitlement checks
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Matt Turner <mturner@resellco.com>, Amy Harris <amy.harris@amazon.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 30 Aug 2025 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: CPPO reseller launch: evidence rotation, demo windows, and entitlement checks

Hi Matt / Amy —

Great to be moving ResellCo toward an AWS CPPO activation. I wanted to capture three parallel asks and propose owners/timing so we can keep the launch on-track for the first-week-of-October pilot: 

1) Evidence rotation (legal / security): AWS will want the CPPO evidence pack (SOC2 summary, data flow appendix, KMS model). I’ve attached an evidence matrix with the gaps we expect. Matt — can your procurement team confirm how they prefer to receive the files (SFTP / secure SharePoint / DocuSign packet)?

2) Demo windows and capacity: ResellCo needs two dry-run demo slots for their field team (internal demo + joint customer-facing demo). Ben — can you confirm demo capacity on our side (GPU-backed demo instance) and any time-of-day constraints?

3) Entitlement checks and SKU mapping: We need to verify SKU -> entitlement mapping for the marketplace listing. Laura — can you run the entitlement checklist against ResellCo’s merchant IDs and flag any mismatches?

Proposed owners & timeline:
- Evidence matrix: Chloe (owner) / Matt (acknowledge) — evidence matrix attached; please confirm method of delivery by Tue 9/2.
- Demo windows: Ben (owner) — propose the week of 9/15 for dry-runs.
- Entitlement mapping: Laura (owner) — target 9/10 for first pass.

Amy — if AWS PM has any required artifacts beyond the matrix I attached, please flag them.

Attachments included: cpop_evidence_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet), demo-runbook.pdf (runbook), resellco-entitlement-checklist.csv (CSV).

Thanks — short meeting later this week if helpful.

—Chloe
Chloe Martin
Senior Partner Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Matt Turner <mturner@resellco.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amy Harris <amy.harris@amazon.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Sep 2025 10:14:00 -0400
Subject: Re: CPPO reseller launch: evidence rotation, demo windows, and entitlement checks

Thanks Chloe — appreciate the clear owners. Quick answers from our side: 

- Procurement prefers secure SharePoint for evidence delivery; could you upload to the ResellCo folder and share a link? If not, SFTP works. We cannot accept DocuSign packets for the full evidence set.
- Field team demo windows: mornings are best (09:00–12:00 ET). For joint customer demos, we need at least one mid-day slot to accommodate EMEA customers (13:00–15:00 ET). Dry-run week of 9/15 works.
- Entitlement mapping: I’ll kick off the merchant ID pull and share the list with Laura by 9/3.

A couple of asks: 
- Can Redwood provide a short one-pager on expected latency/throughput for the demo instance? Our SEs want to set customer expectations.
- Any PII/data retention language we should flag before procurement runs it through our legal?

If it helps, I’m free for a 30-minute sync Tue 9/2 11:00–11:30 ET.

Best,
Matt Turner
Head of Cloud Partnerships
ResellCo Ltd.
mturner@resellco.com

- Coordinate an ephemeral entitlement test token for Laura to run SKU checks against the marketplace staging environment.
